summary: E2E validation of the new UBUNTOO progression feature (7 badges de niveaux + 4 dimensions + charte éthique) and the navbar deduplication. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass on /api/social/auth/sso, /api/social/progression (schema + sequential rule + idempotent level_up), /api/social/charter/accept, and regression on /api/social/posts. Frontend (preview URL): after seeding localStorage with reactif_token + reactif_admin_status=admin, /ubuntoo/profile renders the ubuntoo-progression card with the 7 level-node-* nodes (explorateur→pionnier), clicking level-node-contributeur shows level-detail with criteria + Débloque list, 4 dimension-* bars visible, charter-banner + accept-charter-btn work (banner disappears after accept). When profile is fully completed + charte accepted, level-up-dialog fires with correct 'Vous êtes désormais Explorateur' text and close-celebration-btn dismisses it. Second /progression call returns level_up=false (idempotence verified). Navbar: only one visual logo (image with alt 'Ubuntoo — Je suis parce que nous sommes'); no duplicate 'UBUNTOO / Je suis parce que nous sommes' text (confirmed via navbar.innerText). Feed regression on /ubuntoo: 13 existing posts visible, textarea 'Partagez avec la communauté…' present, publication flow available.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning in console: missing DialogTitle + aria-describedby. Not blocking but should wrap the title with VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle for a11y.

action_items: (A11y, non-blocking) Add DialogTitle inside <DialogContent data-testid="level-up-dialog"> in Progression.jsx (or wrap 'Félicitations ! 🎉' in DialogTitle) to remove the Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Consider splitting UbuntooAncienApp.jsx (>2000 lines) — pre-existing debt from iteration 42, not related to this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: ubuntoo_progression.py: level_up logic is correct — computes achieved_index, compares to stored level_index; persists only on change; awards badge. Sequential rule enforced via `achieved = all(criteria) and achieved_index == i - 1`. Pionnier gated by is_pioneer flag (comité). ✅
compute_stats.days_member uses `datetime.fromisoformat(user['created_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))` — if `created_at` is missing (older accounts pre-schema), fallback to 0. Good defensive handling. ✅
compute_stats.recognitions counts sum of likes + reactions on the user's posts only. This matches the spec ('reconnaissances reçues'). ✅
SSO endpoint auto-provisions Ubuntoo profile using Ré'Actif token — email fabricated from pseudo when identifiant lacks '@' (e.g. 'peter7@reactif.pro'). Idempotent (find_one before insert_one). ✅
Navbar.jsx: only the tag remains; no duplicate 'UBUNTOO' text. Alt text is set for a11y (image already contains the word 'ubuntoo'). ✅

Progression.jsx: no memory leak, useEffect calls load() once; celebrate state toggles from data.level_up. Dialog uses controlled open state — closes cleanly. Missing DialogTitle inside DialogContent (Radix a11y warning). ⚠️
MongoDB _id: ubuntoo_progression queries use projection {_id: 0, ...} — no ObjectId leaks. ✅
get_current_user and award_badge are imported from ubuntoo_social — good code reuse. ✅
test_credentials: peter7 / Solerys777! (charte déjà acceptée, Explorateur). Fresh users are created on the fly via POST /api/auth/register for charter-banner + level-up-dialog testing.
seed_data_creation: Each frontend/backend test class creates TEST_prog_* fresh Ré'Actif Pro accounts via /api/auth/register, then SSO to Ubuntoo. Charter is accepted, profile completed to unlock Explorateur. One TEST_post_* text post created via peter7 to verify the feed regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is https://cv-analyzer-53.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env). To reach /ubuntoo/profile in Playwright: (1) register a fresh Ré'Actif Pro user via POST /api/auth/register {pseudo, password} to get reactif_token; (2) set localStorage keys reactif_token, reactif_role='particulier', reactif_profile_id, reactif_auth_mode='pseudo', reactif_pseudo, reactif_admin_status='admin' (required to bypass AdminGate); (3) navigate to /ubuntoo/profile. The frontend auto-SSOs to Ubuntoo using reactif_token → ubuntoo_jwt via POST /api/social/auth/sso. Key testids: ubuntoo-progression, level-node-{explorateur|contributeur|ambassadeur|expert|mentor|leader|pionnier}, level-detail, dimension-{contribution|expertise|engagement|impact}, charter-banner, accept-charter-btn, level-up-dialog, close-celebration-btn, ubuntoo-navbar, ubuntoo-logo. Level_up dialog fires only on the transition (achieved_index > stored level_index).
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — feature validation, no regression found.
